Read the single-file browser game at /config/workspace/games/zelena-imperija/zelena-imperija.html.
It is a FarmVille-style cannabis-growing tycoon game. Design spec: /config/workspace/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-02-zelena-imperija-design.md.
All player-facing text is Macedonian Cyrillic; all code identifiers are Latin-transliterated
Macedonian (zasadiSemka, parichnik, presmetajKvalitet). This is deliberate — do NOT report
the Macedonian naming or the Macedonian UI as a problem, and do not suggest renaming to English.
It must stay ONE self-contained file with no external assets, no build step, no network calls —
do NOT suggest splitting it into modules, adding a bundler, or adding dependencies.
Report ONLY concrete defects you can point at in the actual code. No speculation, no style
preferences, no "consider adding tests". If you find nothing real in your lens, return an empty list.

You are an adversarial verifier. Below are candidate findings from a "ekonomija" review of that
same file. Your job is to REFUTE each one by reading the actual code. Default to refuted:
mark real=false unless you can point to the exact line(s) proving the defect is genuine and
reachable in normal play. Reject anything that is a style preference, a restatement of an
intentional design decision documented in the spec, a suggestion to add dependencies or split
the file, or a complaint about the Macedonian naming convention.
For findings you confirm, restate a minimal concrete fix and a precise "location" string that
uniquely identifies where to apply it.

CANDIDATE FINDINGS:
[
  {
    "title": "Over-ripening penalty is fully cancelled by passive health recovery — the 14-day ripe window costs nothing, and neglect can be repaired by parking a plant in ZRELO",
    "severity": "high",
    "location": "tikni(), the `if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE;` / `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje;` lines and the `else { r.faza = \"ZRELO\"; ... KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena ... }` block",
    "problem": "KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN is 1.5 per game DAY, while OPORAVUVANJE is 0.4 per TICK = 3.2 per game day for any plant whose voda/hraniva are merely in range and has no pest. Net drift while over-ripe is +1.7/day, so health pins at the clamp. Worse, `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje` runs BEFORE the over-ripe subtraction in the same tick, so the number folded into the lifetime average is the post-recovery clamped 100 every single tick — the penalty never touches `prosekZdravje` at all. Since `prosekZdravje = zbirZdravje / brojTikovi` is an unweighted lifetime mean and is the dominant input to BOTH presmetajPrinos and presmetajKvalitet, leaving a plant ripe indefinitely is free, and it actively launders away earlier neglect. Spec §5 says \"Past the 14-day ripe window the plant over-ripens: quality decays 1.5 points per game day\" — measured decay is zero.",
    "failure_scenario": "Measured, deterministic: plant Скопско Зелено with Автоматско наводнување + Вработен работник bought, never touch it again. It reaches ZRELO with lifetime avg 100.00, then after 5000 further ticks (625 game days past the 14-day window) zdravje reads 99.81 and lifetime avg is still 100.00 — the 'презрело' toast fires once and nothing else happens. Second run, the rescue exploit: never water or feed the plant at all during growth; it reaches ZRELO with zdravje 0 and lifetime avg 21.26 (would grade Слаб, ~9 g). Now start watering it while it sits in ZRELO: after 1904 total ticks avg = 70.85, after 5904 avg = 90.60, after 55904 avg = 99.01. Harvesting at that point yields 59.3 g at quality 72.8 = 'Одличен' (×1.6) — indistinguishable from a perfectly tended plant. Result: harvest timing is a decision with no downside, and a ruined crop is fully recoverable by waiting.",
    "fix": "Two changes in tikni(): (1) move the over-ripe subtraction above `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje` so the penalty actually enters the lifetime average; (2) make the penalty beat recovery — skip the `OPORAVUVANJE` bonus when `preku > 0`, and/or raise KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN above 3.2/day. Cleaner still: stop routing over-ripeness through clamped `zdravje` and accumulate a separate `deoviPrezrelo` counter on the plant (mirroring `deoviSoStetnik`), carry it into the sushara batch in oberi(), and subtract it directly in presmetajKvalitet — that also stops the lifetime-average laundering, since a fixed penalty cannot be diluted by adding ticks."
  },
  {
    "title": "Lamp bonuses are read at harvest and at dry-completion time, so the lamp can be bought retroactively and upgrades everything already in the pipeline",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "oberi(): `presmetajPrinos(sorta, prosekZdravje, tekovnaLampa())`; zavrsiSushenje(): `tekovnaLampa().kvalitetBonus`",
    "problem": "Neither `prinosMult` nor `kvalitetBonus` is captured on the plant at planting time or on the batch at harvest time. Both are looked up live from `sostojba.lampa` at the moment the action resolves, so a lamp bought after a plant has finished growing (or even after it has been harvested and is sitting in the сушара) applies its full effect to that crop.",
    "failure_scenario": "Measured: two Скопско Зелено plants grown to ZRELO entirely under the free Флуо lamp with identical care. Harvest bed 0 → 272.7 g wet. Buy ЛЕД Full-Spectrum, then harvest bed 1 → 409.1 g wet (exactly ×1.50) from a plant that never saw the lamp. Then finish drying BOTH: batch A, which was harvested before the purchase, comes out at quality 87.5 'Врвен' instead of the 73.5 'Одличен' it should have — it collected the +14 kvalitetBonus purely because zavrsiSushenje ran after the lamp was bought. Optimal play is therefore to buy no lamp at all while growing, fill all 12 beds plus the dryer queue, then buy the top tier once and retroactively upgrade every in-flight batch — with 12 Дојранска Ноќ beds that is on the order of 2 M ден of free value, roughly the price of the lamp itself.",
    "fix": "Snapshot the lamp on the crop instead of reading it live: store `prinosMult: tekovnaLampa().prinosMult` on the plant object created in zasadiSemka(), and store `lampaBonus: tekovnaLampa().kvalitetBonus` on the batch pushed in oberi(); have oberi() and zavrsiSushenje() use the stored values. Add the same fallbacks in normalizirajRastenie() and the vchitaj() sushara filter for old saves."
  },
  {
    "title": "Professional Сушара upgrade retroactively re-grades batches already drying, and can jump a batch from 'premature' straight to 'ideal'",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "zavrsiSushenje(): `const tochnost = tochnostOdSushenje(Math.floor(serija.denovi), sostojba.nadgradbi.sushara);`",
    "problem": "Same root cause as the lamp: whether the player owns the сушара is read live at resolution time rather than captured on the batch in oberi(). Because owning it moves the ideal band from 9–12 to 8–14, buying it mid-dry instantly re-classifies every batch currently in the dryer.",
    "failure_scenario": "Measured: two identical batches, both sitting at drying day 8. Finish batch A with no upgrade — day 8 < d1 (9), so tochnost = 0.55 'предвреме', quality 61.4 = 'Среден' (×1.1). Buy Професионална сушара (300 000), then finish batch B in the same instant — day 8 is now within 8–14, tochnost = 1.00, quality 73.5 = 'Одличен' (×1.6). A 45 % price swing on an identical batch from a purchase made after drying finished. The same trick rescues over-dried batches: a batch at day 13 or 14 scores 0.80 without the upgrade and 1.00 with it.",
    "fix": "Capture `imaSushara: sostojba.nadgradbi.sushara` on the batch object pushed in oberi(), and pass `serija.imaSushara` to tochnostOdSushenje(); default it to `false` for batches loaded from older saves in the vchitaj() sushara filter. panelSushara() should use the per-batch flag for its d1/d2 display too, so the window shown matches the window that will be scored."
  },
  {
    "title": "A single Полеј or Ѓубри click on a freshly planted bed is guaranteed to push the plant into the damage band, and repeat Ѓубри charges 250 ден for literally nothing",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "polej(): `r.voda = stegni(r.voda + KONFIG.VODA_DOZA, 0, 100)`; nahrani(): `r.hraniva = stegni(r.hraniva + KONFIG.HRANA_DOZA, 0, 100)` after `naplati(KONFIG.CENA_HRANA)`",
    "problem": "Plants start at voda 70 / hraniva 70 (zasadiSemka). VODA_DOZA is 45 and HRANA_DOZA is 40, but both actions clamp to 100 while the safe ceilings are VODA_MAX 95 and HRANA_MAX 95. 70 + 45 and 70 + 40 both clamp to 100, which is above the ceiling, so the very first care action a player performs on a new bed always starts root rot / nutrient burn. Worse, nahrani() calls naplati() BEFORE checking whether the dose can do anything, so feeding an already-full plant costs 250 ден and delivers zero nutrients while extending the burn. Neither on-bed button is disabled or annotated with the safe range, so nothing signals this.",
    "failure_scenario": "Measured on a fresh Скопско Зелено bed, pari 8000, hraniva 70: click Ѓубри → hraniva 100, pari 7750 (already above HRANA_MAX 95, burn active). Click Ѓубри again → hraniva 100, pari 7500 — 250 ден spent for +0 nutrients. Click again → 7250, still +0. 14 ticks later zdravje has dropped from 100 to 92.60 from a care action the player paid for. The same happens on the first Полеј: voda 70 → 100, which is above VODA_MAX 95, so −0.8/tick root rot until it drains back under 95.",
    "fix": "Clamp the doses to the safe band rather than to 100: `stegni(r.voda + KONFIG.VODA_DOZA, 0, KONFIG.VODA_MAX)` and `stegni(r.hraniva + KONFIG.HRANA_DOZA, 0, KONFIG.HRANA_MAX)` (keep the >MAX damage rules for saves/states that are already above it). In nahrani(), bail out before naplati() when `r.hraniva >= KONFIG.HRANA_MAX` so the player is never charged for a no-op, and disable/relabel the Ѓубри button in iscrtajLeja() while the plant is already full."
  },
  {
    "title": "Plants never die and a completely un-cared-for crop still turns a profit, so the intended failure state does not exist",
    "severity": "low",
    "location": "tikni() health block (`r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje + delta, 0, 100)`) and oberi()/presmetajPrinos — there is no zdravje === 0 death path anywhere",
    "problem": "zdravje is clamped at 0 but nothing consumes that; the plant keeps ageing through every phase, reaches ZRELO, and is harvestable. presmetajPrinos returns `sorta.prinos * Math.pow(zdrav, 1.2) * lampa.prinosMult` with no floor, and presmetajKvalitet has a taban of `30 * genetika` that survives regardless of health, so even a corpse grades above zero. Spec §9 asserts \"With no care at all the same plant loses 95 ден, so neglect is a real failure state\" — that is not what the code does.",
    "failure_scenario": "Measured: plant the free starter Скопско Зелено seed and never click anything. voda hits 0, hraniva hits 0, zdravje reaches 0 by roughly game day 19 and stays there for the remaining ~55 days, yet the plant advances through VEGETACIJA → CVETANJE → ZRELO normally. Harvest and dry it: 9.36 g at quality 24.4 ('Слаб', ×0.6), which sells for roughly 505 ден at pazar 1.0 against a 150 ден seed — a net gain, not a loss. Combined with the over-ripe finding above, a zero-effort player is never punished; they simply earn less.",
    "fix": "Add a death path in tikni(): track consecutive ticks at zdravje === 0 on the plant and, past a threshold (e.g. 3 game days), clear `sostojba.lei[i].rastenie`, fire a Macedonian toast, and set panelValjaSe. Alternatively (or additionally) floor the payout — have presmetajPrinos return 0 below some prosekZdravje threshold — so the seed cost is genuinely lost."
  }
]

content.text: Verified each claim against the code (`CHASA_PO_TIK: 3` → `delDena = 0.125`) and ran a headless simulation of the no-care plant.

verdicts.title: Over-ripening penalty is fully cancelled by passive health recovery, and the unweighted lifetime average lets a ruined plant be rehabilitated in ZRELO
verdicts.reason: Confirmed by arithmetic on the actual constants. CHASA_PO_TIK=3 (line 200) → delDena=0.125, so the ZRELO penalty at line 529 is KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN(1.5)*0.125 = 0.1875 per tick, while `if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE` (line 510) adds 0.4 per tick to any plant whose voda/hraniva are in band and has no pest. Net +0.2125/tick, so zdravje sits pinned at the 100 clamp and over-ripening costs literally nothing — spec line 92 ("quality decays 1.5 points per game day") is not what the code produces. The second half is also real: prosekZdravje = zbirZdravje / brojTikovi (line 661) is an unweighted lifetime mean, ZRELO has no exit condition, and each extra tick adds a fresh 100 to zbirZdravje, so parking a neglected plant in ZRELO with care asymptotically launders its average back toward 100 and restores full yield and grade. One sub-claim in the finding is inaccurate and should not be repeated: the penalty is not permanently invisible to prosekZdravje — line 529 mutates r.zdravje persistently, so it is captured by `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje` (line 513) on the *following* tick. The ordering only delays the penalty by one tick; the reason it never bites is that recovery outweighs it.
verdicts.location: zelena-imperija.html, tikni(): the ZRELO else-branch at line 529 (`r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje - KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena, 0, 100);`) together with line 510 (`if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE;`) and line 513 (`r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje;`)
verdicts.fix: In tikni(), compute `preku` before the health block and skip the OPORAVUVANJE bonus when `preku > 0` so the penalty is not cancelled. To also stop the lifetime-average laundering, add a `deoviPrezrelo` counter on the plant (mirroring `deoviSoStetnik`, initialised in zasadiSemka() at line 623 and normalised in normalizirajRastenie() near line 1187), increment it by `delDena` in the same else-branch, carry it into the sushara batch pushed in oberi() (line ~666), and subtract it directly inside presmetajKvalitet() instead of routing it through the clamped `zdravje`.

verdicts.title: Lamp bonuses are read live at harvest and dry-completion, so a lamp bought later retroactively upgrades everything already in the pipeline
verdicts.reason: Confirmed verbatim in the code. oberi() calls `presmetajPrinos(sorta, prosekZdravje, tekovnaLampa())` at line 662, and zavrsiSushenje() passes `tekovnaLampa().kvalitetBonus` at line 688; `tekovnaLampa()` (line 351) reads `sostojba.lampa` at call time. Neither `prinosMult` nor `kvalitetBonus` is stored on the plant in zasadiSemka() (lines 620-624) or on the batch pushed in oberi() (lines 666-669), and the batch record carries only `{id, sorta, gramaVlazno, denovi, prosekZdravje, deoviSoStetnik}`. So a plant grown entirely under Флуо gets the full ×1.50 yield if the lamp is bought in the instant before harvest, and a batch already sitting in the сушара gets the full +14 quality if the lamp is bought before it is pulled. Reachable in ordinary play — buying a lamp is a normal purchase and every in-flight crop silently benefits.
verdicts.location: zelena-imperija.html, oberi() line 662 (`const suvo = presmetajPrinos(sorta, prosekZdravje, tekovnaLampa());`) and zavrsiSushenje() line 688 (`tekovnaLampa().kvalitetBonus`)
verdicts.fix: Snapshot the lamp instead of reading it live: store `prinosMult: tekovnaLampa().prinosMult` on the plant object created in zasadiSemka() (line 621) and use `r.prinosMult` in oberi(); store `lampaBonus: tekovnaLampa().kvalitetBonus` on the batch pushed in oberi() (line 666) and pass `serija.lampaBonus` in zavrsiSushenje(). Add fallbacks for old saves in normalizirajRastenie() (line ~1185) and the vchitaj() sushara filter.

verdicts.title: Professional Сушара upgrade retroactively re-grades batches already drying
verdicts.reason: Confirmed. zavrsiSushenje() line 685 reads `sostojba.nadgradbi.sushara` live: `const tochnost = tochnostOdSushenje(Math.floor(serija.denovi), sostojba.nadgradbi.sushara);`. tochnostOdSushenje() (lines 448-455) moves the ideal band from 9-12 to 8-14 when the flag is set, so a batch at day 8 scores 0.55 without the upgrade and 1.00 with it, and a batch at day 13-14 scores 0.80 vs 1.00. The batch record built in oberi() (lines 666-669) stores no per-batch flag, so buying the 300 000 упgrade re-grades every batch currently in the dryer. Same root cause as the lamp finding and independently reachable.
verdicts.fix: Add `imaSushara: sostojba.nadgradbi.sushara` to the batch object pushed in oberi() (line 666) and pass `serija.imaSushara` to tochnostOdSushenje() in zavrsiSushenje(); default it to `false` for batches loaded from older saves in the vchitaj() sushara filter, and use the same per-batch flag when panelSushara() renders the d1/d2 window.

verdicts.title: Ѓубри charges 250 ден before checking whether the dose can do anything (the dose-clamp half of this finding is refuted)
verdicts.reason: Split verdict. REFUTED: the claim that clamping the dose to 100 rather than to VODA_MAX/HRANA_MAX is a bug. Spec line 133 specifies exactly `Полевање +45 voda` and `Ѓубриво +40 hraniva`, and spec line ~119 specifies both stats clamp to 0-100; spec line 127 states outright that over-watering hurting is the intended asymmetry that makes the care loop a skill. Lines 633 and 641 implement the spec as written, and the overshoot is avoidable — waiting until voda ≤ 50 gives exactly 95, which is not > VODA_MAX. CONFIRMED: the narrower charging bug. nahrani() (lines 639-645) calls `naplati(KONFIG.CENA_HRANA)` at line 641 before the clamp, so with hraniva already at 100 and no `azot` pest the player is charged 250 ден for a strictly zero effect, repeatably, with the button still enabled and no warning.
verdicts.location: zelena-imperija.html, nahrani() line 641 (`if (!naplati(KONFIG.CENA_HRANA)) return;`) — the call precedes `r.hraniva = stegni(r.hraniva + KONFIG.HRANA_DOZA, 0, 100);` on the next line
verdicts.fix: In nahrani(), before `naplati()`, return early when the dose cannot help and there is nothing to cure: `if (r.hraniva >= 100 && r.stetnik !== "azot") { izvesti(...); return; }`. Optionally disable the Ѓубри button in iscrtajLeja() under the same condition. Do NOT change the +45 / +40 dose values or the 0-100 clamps — those match the spec.

verdicts.title: Plants never die and an un-cared-for crop still turns a profit, contradicting spec §9
verdicts.reason: Confirmed both structurally and numerically. There is no zdravje === 0 death path anywhere: line 512 clamps zdravje to 0 and nothing consumes that value, the phase ladder at lines 516-535 advances on `vozrast` alone, and oberi() (line 656) gates only on `r.faza !== "ZRELO"`. presmetajPrinos() (line 397) has no floor and presmetajKvalitet() (line 438) grants a `30 * genetika` taban regardless of health. I simulated the starter Скопско Зелено with zero care using the exact tick constants: lifetime average health 17.4, yield 7.37 g, quality 22.3 → Слаб (×0.6) → about 398 ден at pazar 1.0 against a 150 ден seed, i.e. roughly +248 net. Spec line 216 asserts the same plant *loses* 95 ден and that neglect is a real failure state; the code pays out instead. (An untreated pest does not change the sign — it drives quality to 0 but the grade is already Слаб ×0.6 and yield is unaffected by the pest kazna.)
